# Maximum Subarray Sum (example problem)

Given an array of n integers, print the largest sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

**Input:** first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5), second line n integers (|a_i| ≤ 10^9).
**Output:** one integer.

This folder is a worked example. `solution.cpp` has a deliberate bug.
Open it and press Ctrl+Shift+B: case 4 fails because naive.cpp gives a different answer.
